scope: Two WB financial template field contracts, safe immutable single-catalog installer, and corrected acceptance-only archived WB financial verifier.

resolved_findings.issue: The original verifier accepted an empty one-page report or missing days as a zero/partial expected total, despite canonical days_cover, and accepted rows spanning multiple days.
resolved_findings.resolution: Updated only the authorized helper: require dateFrom==dateTo, strict ISO daily dates, every day in the requested valid period, and finite Decimal field values. Records full_period_coverage only after those checks.

checks: Exact catalog diff modifies only version, purpose, notes and calculation_contract of B10.finance_for_pay and B10.finance_bank_scheduled; both versions advance 1 to 2. All IDs/count, steps, API requests, formulas, source qualifications and input policies remain unchanged.

Canonical scalar_catalog maps finance_for_pay to forPaySum and finance_bank_scheduled to bankPaymentSum. Both registry metric definitions are signed=true; source decoder uses decimal and recipe sums values. New contracts match those fields and preserve signed sum semantics.

Contract and notes explicitly prohibit substituting the goods-only forPaySum for bankPaymentSum, rebuilding the reported total from selected components, taking an absolute value or replacing a negative result with zero. Spoken bank amount must retain minus.
Missing fields, unknown currency and incomplete responses cannot be treated as zero. Existing financial-period source restrictions and daily coverage qualification remain unchanged.
validate_catalog, exact scope comparison, patch consistency and Python compilation pass.

Installer delta from the prior approved accrual installer changes only release names, pins and source metadata. Only template_catalog.json may differ. Shared immutable files, changed inode replacement, new manifest, full base revalidation, quiescence checks, native preflight, process cwd verification, config equality and rollback remain intact.

Verifier uses existing authenticated archive data and read-only SQLite access, not API/model requests. It supports exactly one short page, rejects duplicate report IDs, checks RUB and requested daily coverage, and sums the selected field with Decimal while preserving its sign.

Actual corrected helper calculation block passed 3 valid probes (negative, confirmed zero and signed multi-day total) plus 5 rejection probes (empty report, missing day, spanning row, NaN and Infinity). No new test file was written.

verification.independent_local: Canonical fields/signed registry/source sum inspected; exact scope/patch/validate_catalog/compile PASS; corrected helper block 8 probes PASS.
verification.server_suite: Fresh 107-test pass required by installer gate; server result not independently observed at review time.

limitations: Live model selection and final signed bank-payment answer require the planned same-question retest after installation.

The helper writes data_check only to the existing private acceptance evidence JSON; archive and application database are read-only. It computes expected values but does not automatically grade spoken text.
Verifier deliberately rejects multi-page or full 1000-row archives rather than claiming pagination completeness.
Unchanged hardlinked release payloads must remain immutable; future changes must replace destination inodes.
